title: Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2605.05703v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimizing the communication structure of large language model based multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) has been shown to improve downstream performance and reduce token usage. Existing methods typically train on randomly sampled tasks. We show that this optimization is sensitive to the choice of training tasks: downstream accuracy varies widely across random task sets, and adding more random tasks does not consistently improve it. To actively identify the most valuable tasks from a pool of task-answer pairs, we propose an ensemble-based information-theoretic task selection framework. It estimates task informativeness by how much a candidate task changes the distribution over graph parameters, using ensemble Kalman inversion as an efficient and derivative-free approximation of the Bayesian update. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的多智能体系统中通信结构优化的主动学习方法
translated_abstract: 优化基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的通信结构已被证明可以提升下游性能并减少token消耗。现有方法通常在随机采样的任务上进行训练。我们表明，这种优化对训练任务的选择非常敏感：下游准确率在不同的随机任务集之间差异很大，且增加更多随机任务并不能持续提升性能。为了从任务-答案对池中主动识别最有价值的任务，我们提出了一种基于集成的信息论任务选择框架。该框架通过候选任务对图参数分布的改变程度来估计任务的信息量，并采用集合卡尔曼反演作为贝叶斯更新的高效无导数近似。由此得到的估计器特别适用于黑盒且含噪声的多智能体系统，并且在集成规模远小于常规设置的情况下仍然保持有效。
tldr: 该论文发现LLM多智能体系统的通信结构优化高度依赖训练任务的选择，并提出了一种基于集成信息论与集合卡尔曼反演的主动任务选择框架，通过主动挑选最具信息量的任务来提升优化效果和下游性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ensemble-based information-theoretic active task selection framework, using ensemble Kalman inversion to identify the most informative training tasks for optimizing the communication structure of LLM-based multi-agent systems.
